he.text: מִתְרַצֶּה בְּרַחֲמִים וּמִתְפַּיֵּס בְּתַחֲנוּנִים הִתְרַצֶּה וְהִתְפַּיֵּס לְדוֹר עָנִי כִּי־אֵין עוֹזֵר׃

en.text: O thou, who art appeased by thy compassion, and art reconciled by supplication, be thou appeased and reconciled to an afflicted generation that hath no other help.
